title: Art Crit Generator
content: If you're in need of a pretentious sounding art critique, try theInstant Art Critique Phrase Generator."It produces whoppers like, "With regard to the issue of content, the mechanical mark-making of the spatial relationships verges on codifying the essentially transitional quality."All you do is type in five random numbers. For example, "54321" yields: "Although I am not a painter, I think that the reductive quality of the spatial relationships contextualize a participation in the critical dialogue of the 90s."------Instant Art Critique Phrase Generator."From BoingBoing.
